text.en:
Section three hundred sixty-nine of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as
"Section 369. Penalty for delinquency.-Failure to pay the real property tax before the expiration of the period
for the collection of the same shall subject the taxpayer to a penalty of ten per centum of the amount of the
original tax due if paid within the first four months of delinquency; twenty per centum of the original tax due
if the tax is paid after four months but before seven months; thirty per centum of the original tax due if the tax
is paid after seven months but before ten months; and forty per centum of the original tax due if the tax is paid
thereafter, to be collected at the same time and in the same manner as the original tax."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 24, 1924.
